CAS_R1_cassette_segment_150.note: dual chamber 17.4 x 17.4: A (power ribbon) y>0, B (signal ribbon) y<0, 14.4 x 7.0 inner, guide ribs on both side walls; print 3 pcs per tube, bond end to end

CAS_R2_trolley.note: slider 12.6 x 5.6 x 18 with 5.5 mm U-loop post (ribbon bend radius 3.0 with ribbon thickness); one per chamber

CAS_R3_end_anchor.note: ribbon clamp block: ribbon end is glued/clamped, drain wire to the foil lining; one at each end

NPM_N1_body_with_tunnel.note: pocket 78 x 20 x 78 for PB1R, 12 mm cable window, straight ribbon tunnel and tube sockets D32.4 (lower fixed tube and upper OUTER tube, both D32)

NPM_N2_lid_with_fill_ports.note: lid with 2 x D8 fill ports (hot zone x -25, main zone x +15) and 2 x D3 vents at the far end; bond with epoxy, fill through the ports under vacuum

NPM_N3_hot_zone_dam.note: vertical dam at x -5 separating the alumina-filled hot zone (FETs, clamp bank) from the syntactic main zone; leave 6 mm gaps top and bottom for the interface

ELB_E1_elbow_and_grip.note: shaft socket D28.8 (inner tube), elbow cavity 48 x 40 and grip cavity 31 x 37 hold PM1, HB1 and the 1 F supercap bridge; fill ports D8 + D3 vent on the elbow top; grip 36 x 42 stadium, 163 mm

ELB_E3_trigger.note: trigger lever (magnet in the tip over the HB1 Hall sensor, travel 0-4 mm), index-finger curve

ELB_E4_joystick_boss.note: thumb joystick boss and stick, sits on the grip top at x = 95 mm

ELB_E5_forearm_cuff.note: forearm cuff D86 inner, 55 mm wide, centred 55 mm above the grip axis so the forearm rests ABOVE the battery drawer; bridge arm to the grip end; strap slots to be added by the user

BAT_B1_drawer_sleeve.note: U-pack drawer 41 x 23 inside, 312 mm long, hangs under the grip: 4+3 U-pack 290 x 38 x 20 plus contacts; bonded under the elbow and grip with 4 M3 inserts

BAT_B2_end_cap_with_latch.note: end cap with push latch boss; O-ring groove to be added, pressure-relief membrane in the cap

BAT_B3_contact_plate.note: contact receptacle: NEG, PRE (22 ohm pre-charge), POS, ID blade pads (same sequence as the v4 cartridge: NEG first, POS last)
